svg.title: Lyrata technician onboarding journey map
svg.desc: Journey map showing a new technician's experience across five stages: arrival, grow chamber, sowing, daily tasks, and end of shift — with emotions, pain points, and opportunities at each stage.
svg.text: Based on Day 1–4 field observation, June 2025
Source: Day 1–4 shadowing notes, Lyrata Hydroponics, June 2025 — M. Ashraf
